name: default
notes: Play-Along stage theme. Colours only — geometry lives in the renderer. Lengths in this file are px at a 1080px-tall stage; scale linearly with stage height unless marked fixed. Round 2 revisions: the slide is now a contour rail (slideRail*), the legato join is a flush butt with a union outline (legatoJoin*, nickGap), hammer-on/pull-off arcs anchor to pill centres (hammerArcAnchor), the chord block keeps its length and lets a long name run past it (chordName*), and P.M. can rail above the string it is played on (pmRailPlacement).

valueNotes.slideRail: Ink of the slide contour rail. Cream + markHalo so it survives OBS. Set slideRailUseFingerColour true to draw the rail in the chain's finger colour instead (one finger moves, so a slide chain has exactly one colour).
valueNotes.slideRailWidth: Stroke weight of the rail. 7px at 1080 — same weight as the hammer arc so the two read as one family.
valueNotes.slideRailTop: Gap from the top of the lane to the topmost level.
valueNotes.slideRailMaxLevels: Levels available to one chain before it clamps.
valueNotes.slideRailPlateauInset: How far each plateau stops short of its pill's own left/right edge.
valueNotes.slideRailMinPlateau: If a note is too short to carry a plateau this long, the plateau is dropped and the riser runs corner to corner.
valueNotes.slideRailLandingTick: Optional short downward tick at the arrival end of a chain, 0 = off.
valueNotes.slideRailPerShape: When the same slide happens on several strings at once, draw ONE rail above the topmost string of the shape instead of one per string.
valueNotes.nickGap: Ground showing between consecutive picked notes. Raised 7→9 so the nick is clearly wider than a legato seam.
valueNotes.legatoJoinGap: Ground between the two pills of a legato pair (hammer-on, pull-off, legato slide): zero. The pills butt flush at full height and their own corner radii pinch the seam into two small notches. No bridge element is drawn.
valueNotes.legatoJoinOutline: 'union' = the keyline traces the outside of the merged silhouette only, so no hairline crosses the seam. 'per-pill' restores two separate outlines.
valueNotes.legatoSeamOverlap: Pills overlap by this many px at the seam before the union outline is traced — kills the antialiasing hairline. Does not change note width or timing.
valueNotes.hammerArcAnchor: 'pill-centre' = the arc springs from and lands on the horizontal centre of each pill. Feet sit on the pill's top edge; apex is midway between the two centres, hammerArcRise above it. 'pill-edge' restores the old inner-edge anchoring.
valueNotes.chordPillObs: Chord block in OBS mode — one step lighter so the plum does not sink into a dark camera feed.
valueNotes.chordPillKeyline: Hairline around the chord block so it holds its shape over video.
valueNotes.chordNameMinSizeRatio: Floor for chord-name type: 0.0259 × stage height = 28px at 1080. The name shrinks to this and no further.
valueNotes.chordNameOverflow: What a name does when it will not fit at the floor. 'right' = the block stays exactly as long as the chord and the name continues past its right edge as cream stage text with a halo, left-aligned to the block. 'shrink' restores the old behaviour.
valueNotes.pmRailPlacement: 'nearest-lane' draws P.M. and its dashed rule in the clear lane above the highest muted string. 'header' restores the top-of-stage rail.
valueNotes.markHaloWidth: Dark halo behind every cream mark — the only thing keeping marks legible in OBS.
